name: Sapphire Echo
description: Cast an echo tinted deep blue beside the user so that an opponent's attention splits between the two shapes.

name: Glassy Double
description: Hold a glassy double at an angle to a soul-bolt so that the bolt slides off its smooth face.

name: Airy Crossing
description: Throw the likeness a light pace ahead and carry the body into its place without a sound.

name: Clouded Mirror
description: Cloud the likeness so that it hangs unseen in the room and shows the user every soul that looks toward the user.

name: Bright Counterpart
description: Send a bright counterpart to strike the soul of an opponent a heartbeat before the user's own blow falls.

name: Sapphire Ward
description: Set the likeness before the user as a sapphire ward that bears a long press of soul force.

name: Radiant Pair
description: Stand user and likeness side by side in equal light so that every soul-strike aimed at one is spent against the other.

name: Sundering Likeness
description: Drive the likeness through an opponent's soul-guard like a wedge so that it splits the guard from within.

name: Sapphire Passage
description: Turn the body into its own likeness for one breath and pass through a barrier of qi as if it were not there.

name: Vigil Shade
description: Post a shade at the user's back where it keeps watch and takes the first soul-strike from behind.

name: Dull Figure
description: Show a plain sentry figure so dull that an opponent's eye slides over the true body beside it.

name: Short Stride
description: Take one short stride through the shade and appear at its side before an opponent has turned.

name: Warding Silhouette
description: Hold a warding silhouette between the user and an opponent so that its edge blunts a rising soul-assault.

name: Needling Shade
description: Run a needling shade into the thin place of an opponent's soul-guard and prick the soul behind it.

name: Reading Double
description: Let a reading double circle a group of souls and tell the user which of them is ready to strike.

name: Ranked Shades
description: Set shades in ranks one behind another so that a heavy soul-strike must tear through every rank to reach the user.

name: Shade Reckoning
description: Bring the ranks down together on a single opponent in one reckoning that lands as a heavy shock of soul force.

name: Undying Sentinel
description: Fix a sentinel that takes each soul-strike into itself and feeds the force back into its own shape so it does not fall.

name: Folded Copy
description: Fold a copy into the user's own outline so that the opponent sees one figure that seems to blur and double.

name: Deft Shade
description: Slip a deft shade between the user and a thrust of soul force and push the thrust aside.

name: Wire Stride
description: Take a narrow step through the double and leave it standing where the user was.

name: Tapping Echo
description: Tap the echo against an opponent's temple so that a small jolt of soul force confuses the next move.

name: Doubled Guard
description: Hold two doubles in a close guard so that one takes the blow and the other stands ready to take the next.

name: Switching Likeness
description: Switch the user and the likeness in mid stride so that the opponent's strike meets only the likeness.

name: Probing Twin
description: Send the twin round an opponent to read the soul's strength and the weak side of its guard.

name: Twin Rebound
description: Let the twin take a soul-strike and return it along the line it came by so that it hits the sender.

name: Doubled Execution
description: Bring user and double down together on one opponent so that two full blows of soul force land as one.

name: Absolute Counterpart
description: Cast a counterpart that is the user in every mark of soul and bearing so that no sense can tell the two apart.

name: Unseen Escort
description: Keep an unseen escort close to the user to stand against a soul-strike before it is seen.

name: Quiet Attendant
description: Let a quiet attendant walk ahead and carry the user's weight a stride forward with it.

name: Soft Watcher
description: Set a soft watcher at the edge of the field to report any soul that draws near.

name: Silent Lunge
description: Lunge with a silent echo so that the strike arrives with no stir in the soul-field to warn of it.

name: Hidden Retinue
description: Keep the retinue hidden in the user's own presence so that soul-sense counts one soul where several stand.

name: Tailing Guard
description: Send a following guard to meet each soul-bolt in turn and bend it from the user's line.

name: Retinue Rush
description: Rush the whole retinue at one opponent so that a flurry of small soul-strikes lands within a breath.

name: Retinue Sweep
description: Sweep the retinue across the field so that every opponent in its path takes a blow of soul force.

name: Unseen Muster
description: Gather the retinue unseen round the opponents so that they feel themselves watched from every side.

name: Dissolving Retinue
description: Let the retinue break apart as a soul-strike lands so that each echo takes a share of the force and dissolves with it.

name: Stormwing Echo
description: Dive an echo at an opponent on a fast stroke that jolts the soul as it passes.

name: Pinion Shade
description: Beat the shade's pinions once and let the lift carry the user a long step aside.

name: Feathered Double
description: Shake out a feathered double whose flutter hides the true body from soul-sense.

name: Beating Image
description: Beat the image against an incoming soul-bolt so that the bolt is flung wide.

name: Pinion Cloak
description: Spread the phantom's wings round the user as a veil that bears a steady press of soul force.

name: Diving Shade
description: Drop a shade in a steep dive on the soul of an opponent and hit it hard from above.

name: Soaring Likeness
description: Raise the likeness on a rising draught of force and see every soul in a wide ring from its height.

name: Stormwing Rake
description: Rake a flight of phantoms across the opponents so that each is clawed by the passing wings.

name: Raptor Double
description: Stoop the double on an opponent from above so that the opponent looks up and takes the true strike from the front.

name: Tempest Phantasm
description: Raise a storm of winged phantoms that breaks over the whole field and tears at every soul beneath it.

name: Spoken Echo
description: Speak a word and let the echo repeat it from another quarter so that the sound seems to come from the wrong body.

name: Oath Shade
description: Bind a shade to an oath of protection so that it stands in front of the user and holds.

name: Vowed Crossing
description: Bind a pace to the wraith and let it carry the user the same distance in the same breath.

name: Vow Image
description: Hold a vow image up to a nearby soul and feel whether the soul keeps faith with it.

name: Pledged Double
description: Pledge the double to an ally so that it stands by that ally and takes a soul-strike meant for them.

name: Witness Shade
description: Leave a witness shade with a soul and learn afterward what that soul said and did.

name: Broken Pledge
description: Send the wraith against a soul that has broken a given word so that the strike lands harder for the breach.

name: Sworn Reflection
description: Meet a soul-strike with a reflection sworn to the user and throw the force back at the sender.

name: Voice of Wraiths
description: Let many wraiths speak at once in a voice that weighs on an opponent's soul and presses its technique lower.

name: Keeper Wraith
description: Stand a wraith over the allies who swore with the user so that it shields them and steadies each soul it keeps.

name: Drift Image
description: Let an image drift and follow it with one slow step to a place the opponent did not mark.

name: Lingering Shade
description: Leave a lingering shade at the user's flank that stays after the user has moved on.

name: Far Double
description: Send a double far across the soul-field and hear what it meets before it returns.

name: Patient Image
description: Hold a patient image so still that an opponent forgets it and then starts when it moves.

name: Thin Wraith
description: Pass a thin wraith through an opponent's guard so that it leaves a cold jolt in the soul.

name: Fleet Doubles
description: Loose a fleet of doubles in all directions so that the opponent cannot choose a target.

name: Trailing Phantom
description: Set a phantom on an opponent's trail so that the user always knows where that soul has gone.

name: Counter Image
description: Raise a counter image that returns a thin share of a soul-strike to its sender.

name: Spreading Phantoms
description: Spread phantoms over a wide field so that opponents lose all sense of where the user and allies stand.

name: Hunting Phantoms
description: Loose a pack of phantoms that run down the scattered opponents and strike each soul in turn.

name: Deep Echo
description: Send an echo down into the opponents' souls so that it presses their techniques to a crawl until it fades.

name: Final Whisper
description: Whisper in the user's own voice from far off so that an opponent hears a dying double speak.

name: Parting Image
description: Give the parting image to a soul-bolt so that it spends itself on the leaving shape.

name: Closing Shade
description: Close the shade on an opponent so that its chill folds round the soul for an instant.

name: Leaving Step
description: Take a leaving step through the fading twin and arrive well clear of the blow.

name: Fading Twin
description: Let a fading twin pass among the souls nearby and read their weight as it dims.

name: Seeded Form
description: Plant a seed of the user's form in an opponent's soul-field and let it flower into a blow.

name: Mourning Echo
description: Raise an echo that weeps for the opponent so that grief clouds the opponent's aim.

name: Remembered Face
description: Wear a remembered face and read how each soul responds to it.

name: Standing Entity
description: Raise a whole entity of the user's soul that stands apart and bears a heavy assault in the user's stead.

name: Final Likeness
description: Spend a likeness in a single thrust that pierces every layer of an opponent's soul-guard.

name: Last Echo
description: Spend the standing entity in one final cry that strikes the soul itself and ignores every ward before it.
